stem.en: Cyclones in the North Indian Ocean get their names from a list. Which statement about that list is true?

text.en: 13 names, sent in by 169 member countries, in order

feedback.en: The numbers are the other way round: 169 names from 13 countries.

text.en: 169 names, sent in by 13 countries, used in order

feedback.en: Yes. The list has 169 names from 13 member countries, including India, and they are used one after another.

text.en: 169 names, each chosen by the country hit first

feedback.en: Names are not chosen by the country hit. They are used in order from the list.

text.en: A new list, chosen afresh by India every single year

feedback.en: The list is shared by 13 member countries and is not made afresh each year.

explanation.en: The list has 169 names sent in by 13 member countries, including India, and the names are used one after another. This helps clear communication and public awareness.

hints.en: One option turns the two numbers round.
